title: Critical Diffusion Limits and Wald Inference for Randomized Service-System Capacity Experiments
banked_reason: D0.5.G tier=subfield < floor=field and NOT salvageable in scope.
gap_reasons: Its econometric reach is constrained by stationary initialization, observed recovery-cause marks, independent equal-sized arms, homogeneous rates, and a known compact critical-staffing regime.

The capacity result optimizes a model-specific staffing-versus-interval-width objective using supplied rate inputs and computable-real receipts, but provides neither an instantiated certificate nor a substantive staffing exercise showing that the recommendation changes operational decisions.
These restrictions and the absence of reproducible application-level evidence keep the package below flagship significance despite the delivered field-level theory.
Not salvageable within scope — bank downgraded, or re-anchor the proposal (rewind D-1.2).
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved the compact-uniform critical occupation/score limit, the kink-inclusive generator-residual bound, exact fixed-capacity fitted-center Wald theory, and an oracle-relative capacity certificate and finite-system regret transfer. The mathematics survived D0 review and the Boutilier scope citation was verified directly, but D0.5 capped the package at subfield because the stationary equal-arm marked-history model and absence of an instantiated operational application do not clear the field-level significance bar. A future re-raise should re-anchor around a broader empirical or design contribution rather than repeat the completed critical-diffusion derivations.
tldr: For equal-arm stationary homogeneous marked-history service experiments, the paper derives a compact-uniform joint occupation-and-rate-score Gaussian law from exact finite-chain Poisson martingales. Evaluating the exact stationary product law at estimated rates while holding implemented capacity fixed gives fitted-center variance \(Q=A^{\mathsf T}\Gamma A\), residual variance \(W=V-Q\), and uniformly valid Wald coverage for arbitrary joint divergence of \(N\) and \(T_N\). The proved kink residual makes the diffusion center an \(O(N^{-1})\)-accurate corollary under \(T_N=o(N)\). For capacity choice, the staffing radius \(G\) is an exact nonnegative rational design datum; explicit energy, tail, transcendental, and split-quadrature bounds construct a sound rational objective oracle on \([-G,G]\), and rational dyadic branch-and-bound returns a finite checkable certificate.
gap: The operational-dosage literature provides a finite-system long-duration law and a separate fluid threshold, while its planning calculations assume oracle queueing quantities. Static steady-state diffusion approximation and fixed-chain score sensitivity do not close the joint critical inference problem.
fill: The paper establishes stationary path and generator convergence for the named scaled lattices, proves the exact-centered joint Gaussian law without an artificial horizon exponent, isolates the kink residual needed for fitted intervals under \(T_N=o(N)\), and returns a rational interval certificate with explicit semantics and finite worst-case complexity.
